content: Resend SDK 6.18.1 is current stable. Pattern: const resend = new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY); const { data, error } = await resend.emails.send({from, to, subject, html/text/react}). Use in Next.js as Route Handler (app/api/send/route.ts) or Server Action. Destructured { data, error } response pattern — don't use try/catch for SDK errors. Domain must be verified in Resend dashboard before production.
